summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate funding in maintaining reliable internet connectivity for its students and educators. Without E-Rate, the district would face significant financial challenges that could compromise educational quality.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate would lead to severe financial strain on districts, forcing compromises on educational quality
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-Rate funding, our component districts would face severe financial strain, directly forcing a compromise on the quality of student education.
